# How to build with EDU?

- [ ] [The Edu Framework directory structure](arborescence.md)

## 1. Build your first page

To build your first page, follow these instructions:

- [How to build with a controller](controller-edu.md)


## 2. Build a form in a page

To create a form in a page, follow these instructions:

- [How to build a form using the POST method with a controller](controller-edu-post.md)

## 3. Build the CRUD

To build the full CRUD of an entity (Create, Read, Update, Delete), follow these instructions:

- [How to build the CRUD for the ville (city) entity](dataservice-select.md)

## 4. Build a CLI command

To create a new command, follow these instructions:

- [How to build a CLI command](new-command-edu.md)

## 5. Build an API

To create a JSON API (controller, route and OpenAPI documentation), follow these instructions:

- [How to build an API](controller-edu-api.md)

## 6. Test your application

To automatically check that your code works correctly with PHPUnit, follow these instructions:

- [How to set up unit tests](tests-unitaires.md)
